name: Fund Order Type 10 Code
definition: Specifies a type of investment fund transaction.

SUBS.name: Subscription
SUBS.definition: Investment fund order is a subscription.

RDIV.name: Reinvestment Of Dividend
RDIV.definition: Investment fund order is a dividend reinvestment (only applicable to a subscription).

REDM.name: Redemption
REDM.definition: Investment fund order is a redemption.

RGSV.name: Regular Savings Plan
RGSV.definition: Investment fund order is a regular savings plan (only applicable to a subscription).

WIDP.name: Withdrawal
WIDP.definition: Investment fund order is for a withdrawal investment plan (only applicable to a redemption).
